macros.name: branchheight
macros.doc: The distance between levels can be adjusted by using \branchheight.

macros.name: childattachsep
macros.doc: The length \childattachsep indicates the minimum distance between the attachment points of two children.

macros.name: childsidesep
macros.doc: The minimum horizontal separation between edges of two children is set by \childsidesep.
